nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 of reflection balances; core accounting state mutated on every transfer.
Mapping address=>uint256 of token balances (declared, effectively unused in this implementation).
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 approval amounts consumed by transferFrom.
Mapping flagged addresses exempt from fees and cooldown/max-tx logic.
Mapping of addresses blocked from transferring by owner-controlled bot list.
Mapping address=>timestamp enforcing minimum time between buys, written with block.timestamp.
Constant total token supply (1e12 * 10**9).
Total reflections supply, reduced on every fee reflection via _reflectFee.
Accumulated token-denominated fee total, incremented during reflection.
Mutable fee rate (2%) packed into storage and re-written on every transfer.
Mutable team fee rate (10%) packed into storage and re-written on every transfer.
Payable fee wallet 1 receiving half of swapped ETH; also the authorization identity for manualswap/manualsend.
Payable fee wallet 2 receiving half of swapped ETH.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, liquidity and pair creation.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading; drives fee logic branches.
Boolean gate set true in openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Boolean enabling the automatic token-to-ETH swap inside _transfer.
Boolean toggling the per-address buy cooldown enforcement.
Maximum transfer size enforced only on pair-source transfers.
Private core transfer: enforces bot/zero checks, sets fee rates, applies cooldown, triggers swap-and-send ETH, then performs reflection transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer entrypoint delegating to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens then subtracts allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve entrypoint delegating to _approve.
Private approval writer with zero-address validation, also used to approve the router.
Owner-only toggle of the cooldown feature flag.
Private lockTheSwap-guarded swap of contract tokens to ETH through the Uniswap router.
Private distribution of contract ETH to the two fee wallets using .transfer.
Owner-only initialization: sets router, approves, creates pair, adds liquidity and enables swap/cooldown.
Owner-only bulk bot blacklisting loop.
Owner-only reset of _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
Owner-only removal of an address from the bot blacklist.
Private indirection wrapper calling _transferStandard.
Private reflection math transfer: debits/credits _rOwned, takes team tokens, reflects fees, emits Transfer.
Private allocation of team tokens into the contract's reflection balance.
Private reflection accounting: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Externally callable manual swap guarded by a hardcoded wallet comparison against msg.sender.
Externally callable manual ETH distribution guarded by a hardcoded wallet comparison against msg.sender.
Private helper returning r/t values derived from the mutable fee rates stored in state.
Private pure computation of fee, team and transfer token amounts.
Private pure computation of reflection amounts from the current rate.
Private rate computation rSupply / tSupply used by all reflection conversions.
Private supply reader with a tautological divergence check.
Private conversion from reflection amount to token amount with an upper-bound require.
Public balance view converting the stored reflection balance into token units.
Public pure supply getter returning the constant _tTotal.
Owner-only owner renouncement inherited from Ownable.
Internal context helper returning msg.sender.
Empty receive() hook that lets the contract accept ETH from swaps and liquidity operations.
msg.sender, controls token transfers, approvals and the manualswap/manualsend authorization checks.
block.timestamp, used for buy cooldown enforcement and as swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin = 0 and a miner-influenced deadline.
ETH value transfer to _feeAddrWallet1 executed inside the swap-send flow.
ETH value transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 executed inside the swap-send flow.
External payable addLiquidityETH call spending the entire contract ETH balance with zero minimums.
External factory.createPair call returning the pair address trusted without validation.
External IERC20(pair).approve granting the router an unlimited allowance.

Array of addresses to blacklist in setBots.
Address to remove from the bot blacklist in delBot.

Boolean toggle parameter of setCooldownEnabled.
Snapshot of the contract's token balance before the swap inside _transfer.
Snapshot of the contract's ETH balance used to decide distribution inside _transfer.

Reflection amount returned by _getValues inside _transferStandard.

edges.reason: _msgSender() simply returns the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit sender of the transfer.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
manualswap authorization relies solely on comparing msg.sender to a hardcoded fee wallet.
manualsend authorization relies solely on comparing msg.sender to a hardcoded fee wallet.
Buy cooldown mapping is written using miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
_rOwned drives the contract balance snapshot taken inside _transfer.
_transferStandard debits and credits the _rOwned reflection mapping.
balanceOf reads the _rOwned reflection balance.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to derive the rate.
_getCurrentSupply reads the constant _tTotal supply.
totalSupply returns the constant _tTotal.
transferFrom consumes the _allowances mapping for the spender.
_tOwned is declared alongside the allowance accounting in the transfer path.
_isExcludedFromFee bypasses fee, cooldown and max transaction checks in _transfer.
bots mapping blocks transfers from or to blacklisted addresses.
cooldown mapping is read and written inside _transfer.
_feeAddr1 is passed as the tax fee rate into _getTValues.
_feeAddr2 is passed as the team fee rate into _getTValues.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH balance to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH balance to _feeAddrWallet2.
swapTokensForEth uses the stored router for the swap and approval.
openTrading writes and uses the stored router instance.
uniswapV2Pair determines cooldown and fee branches in _transfer.
openTrading assigns the pair address and approves it.
inSwap guard prevents nested swap execution in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap and ETH distribution branch.
cooldownEnabled gates the timestamp-based cooldown requirement.
_maxTxAmount caps the amount for pair-source transfers.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee total in _tFeeTotal.
transfer() delegates to the private _transfer implementation.
transferFrom() calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve to deduct the spent allowance.
approve() delegates to the private _approve writer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply the reflection transfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard allocates team tokens via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard derives amounts through _getValues.
_getValues computes token values via _getTValues.
_getValues computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate via _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection converts using the rate from _getRate.
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
_transfer performs an external router swap and ETH payout before the reflection transfer completes.
_transfer forwards the contract ETH balance to fee wallets via an external value transfer.
swapTokensForEth approves the router for the swapped amount via _approve.
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears the inSwap guard around the swap.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router swap call that can hand control to third parties.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to fee wallet 2.
openTrading supplies all contract ETH through addLiquidityETH with zero minimums.
openTrading creates the Uniswap pair via the factory.
openTrading grants the router an unlimited allowance on the pair token.
The router swap returns ETH to the contract, invoking the receive() hook mid-transfer.
setBots writes true flags into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot clears the bots blacklist flag for an address.
removeStrictTxLimit overwrites _maxTxAmount with the full supply.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled feature flag.
from parameter flows into the transfer logic and bot/zero-address checks.
to parameter flows into pair detection and fee branching.
amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and used in the transfer.
sender parameter is used to debit the reflection balance.
recipient parameter is used to credit the reflection balance.
tAmount parameter is decomposed by _getValues.
tTeam parameter is multiplied by the rate and credited to the contract.
rFee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal.
tFee parameter is added to _tFeeTotal.
tokenAmount parameter is the amount swapped and approved to the router.
amount parameter is halved and transferred to both fee wallets.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping loop.
notbot parameter is the key cleared in the bots mapping.
spender parameter is stored in the allowances mapping.
onoff parameter is written into cooldownEnabled.
contractTokenBalance local holds the pre-swap contract token balance.
contractETHBalance local gates the ETH distribution call.
path local array defines the swap route [token, WETH].
currentRate local is used to convert reflections to tokens.
rAmount local is the reflection amount debited from the sender.
currentRate local converts tTeam into reflection units.

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter of _transfer; intrinsic to that function signature.
Address parameter of _transfer; used only inside that function.
Amount parameter of _transfer; validated and forwarded inside that function.
Sender parameter of _transferStandard; consumed only there.
Recipient parameter of _transferStandard; consumed only there.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard; consumed only there.
Team token amount parameter of _takeTeam; consumed only there.
Reflection fee parameter of _reflectFee; consumed only there.
Token fee parameter of _reflectFee; consumed only there.
Amount parameter of swapTokensForEth; consumed only there.
ETH amount parameter of sendETHToFee; split between the two fee wallets.
Address array parameter of setBots; iterated only inside that function.
Address parameter of delBot; used only as the cleared mapping key.
Spender parameter of approve; forwarded to _approve.
Boolean parameter of setCooldownEnabled; written directly to state.
Local snapshot used only for the auto-swap decision in _transfer.
Local ETH snapshot used only to gate sendETHToFee in _transfer.
Local swap route array used only in swapTokensForEth.
Local rate value computed and used only in tokenFromReflection.
Local reflection amount used only to debit the sender in _transferStandard.
Local rate value used only to size the team allocation in _takeTeam.
